provenance.bg.base: spec: gruvbox.vim bg0 = light0 (Normal bg, medium contrast)
provenance.bg.inset: choice: gruvbox's own 'hard' background (inverted ladder: lighter than bg0)
provenance.fg.muted: spec: fg ladder; fg4 (dark4) is 4.29:1 on light0, fg3 (dark3, same ladder role) 5.74:1
provenance.fg.on-accent: spec: Search/IncSearch draw bg0 on yellow/orange (inverse)
provenance.fg.title: spec: Title = green bold (light uses faded_*)
provenance.accent.primary: spec: PmenuSel = blue; light uses faded_*
provenance.accent.secondary: choice: categorical contrast with blue; light accent set faded_*
provenance.status.error: spec: ErrorMsg red; light accent set faded_*
provenance.status.warning: choice: faded_yellow is 3.33:1 on light0; orange is gruvbox's other warning hue (ports: bright_orange 1/3) and passes 5.40:1

notes: Discrepancy (ANSI 0): gruvbox-contrib light xresources sets color0 = #fdf4c1, which is not a palette color (light0 = #fbf1c7). Kept the port value (it is what that terminal config shows; the two differ by 1.02:1); no token references it.

Light accents are the faded_* set; faded_yellow (3.33:1) fails as text so status.warning uses faded_orange (5.40:1). Note faded_orange and faded_red are close in hue: always pair warning/error with distinct glyphs.
